propositions: Four review-interrupt firings on 2026-08-12 exceeded the DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX=1800s bound by 10–130s (observed deferred_for values 1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s), each killing an in-flight LLM-Review and stalling the gate
The review deferral bound was originally sized at 1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (1200s) but burst landing volumes (60+ merges) cause marginal overshoots that a larger bound would eliminate
DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX raised from 1800s to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) and the test constraint tightened from >= 1x to >= 2x to enforce the relationship and prevent drift

The raise is bounded to a fixed multiple of the app's per-review cap to remain self-adjusting and not defer indefinitely; a saturated episode (unconfirmed in Aug-12 data) would still require a drain signal separate from the timer
The terraform monitoring comment restating 1800s corrected to 2400s; no resource attribute changes, so no operator apply required
